exports.behavior: Validates the complete slice, counts exact bytes and Unicode scalars, and identifies ASCII-only input. Empty input returns the default summary. No allocation or normalization occurs.

Checks the ABI length limit before backend validation and returns the exact immutable input borrow. Uses the existing optional ps_simdutf8::compat::from_utf8 facade under simd-utf8 and core::str::from_utf8 otherwise. Maps malformed and truncated sequences to canonical InvalidUtf8 errors at valid_up_to(), with Utf8 source and default schema and field identifiers.

test_vectors: Empty input, all 128 ASCII byte values, NUL, controls, JSON punctuation, and DEL.
Explicit scalar boundaries: U+0000, U+007F, U+0080, U+07FF, U+0800, U+D7FF, U+E000, U+FDD0, U+FFFE, U+FFFF, U+10000, and U+10FFFF.
Mixed scalar widths, combining characters, an emoji ZWJ sequence, preserved BOMs, U+FFFD, and literal JSON escape bytes.
Exact pointer and lifetime preservation for borrowed subslices, including empty subslices and invalid surrounding bytes.
Every non-ASCII single byte, isolated continuation bytes, forbidden leaders, overlong encodings, surrogate halves and pairs, five- and six-byte forms, and values above U+10FFFF.
Invalid continuation substitutions at every continuation position, malformed short prefixes, and every incomplete prefix of representative valid multibyte encodings.
First-error byte offsets after multibyte prefixes and before later errors; code, source, schema ID, field ID, and diagnostic assertions.
Two-, three-, and four-byte sequences beginning at offsets 0 through 129, at 16 input alignments, with truncated and malformed tails and 65-byte ASCII suffixes.
Differential comparison against core for all 256 one-byte inputs and all 65,536 two-byte inputs.
Deterministic mutations at every position of a 260-byte valid mixed-width input, compared against core both as complete slices and truncated prefixes.
Shared ABI length guard at zero, one, and representable u32::MAX; on 64-bit targets, overflow at u32::MAX + 1, u32::MAX + 2, and usize::MAX without oversized allocations or fabricated slices.

status.review: Source reviewed against the frozen contract, root types, canonical ABI errors, and the neighboring dependency's safe compatibility API.
status.inline_tests: 14 test functions authored, including one conditional on a 64-bit pointer width; not executed.
status.execution: No build, check, test, compiler, formatting, or commit commands were run, as instructed.
status.dependency_scope: No dependencies or manifests changed. Uses jmax-abi root exports and the optional ps-simdutf8 integration already declared and explicitly required by the frozen Wave 1 contract.
status.safety: No unsafe code, direct ISA calls, allocation, global state, or input mutation. Both backend configurations support no-std use.
status.limitations: Compilation and runtime behavior remain unverified. Oversized-input tests exercise the shared length guard directly rather than allocating a slice larger than 4 GiB.
